pkgmetadata.longdescription: Qoder Wake is Qoder's local agent runtime. It hosts and orchestrates coding agents, and connects them to IM channels and browser connectors. It bundles its own agent CLI as qodercli/qodercli-wake. This package installs the prebuilt upstream tree.
Qoder Wake 是 Qoder 推出的本地智能体运行时, 承载并调度编程 智能体, 可接入 IM 渠道和浏览器连接器, 自带配套的 qodercli/qodercli-wake。本软件包安装上游预编译的程序目录。
